description:
The Workforce Profiles datasets provide B.C. Public Service representation statistics on employees who identify themselves as women, Indigenous, persons with disabilities, racialized, and 2SLGBTQ+. 

Demographic data is gathered through BC Stats' corporate surveys and the resulting statistics are used to produce the B.C. Public Service Workforce Profiles.

Comparator data comes from federal reports, including the Canadian Census, Canadian Survey on Disability, and Canadian Community Health Survey. Comparators use the most recent data available at the time of analysis.
notes: Source table rows are aggregate observations or ministry lookups, never individual employee records.
All cells preserve source strings. S, NA and empty fields are not zero; no suppressed values are reconstructed.
Year labels identify profile editions. Historical comparison columns may refer to earlier years.
Employee counts, percentages, comparators, hiring flows and ministry lookup records have different units and denominators. Do not sum across tables or overlapping groups.
These profiles are separate from FOI average headcount and average salary, named compensation disclosures and fiscal-year FTE statistics.
